intent:
New feature: drag or paste (Cmd+V) an image into the message box so the agent can look at it. It works in a new session and in follow-up messages, and shows in the chat after a reload.

In the box:

- Images stand in a row above the text, 8px apart, as 120x120 tiles with 10px corners; the whole image fits, on a dark tile.
- On hover, a small round X on the tile's top-right corner removes it.
- A click opens the image large; X or Esc closes it.

Decide the rest yourself and list your choices in the pull request. Keep the image files on this computer only: not in the checkout, not in the shared agent data. Add tests, test it by hand in a real browser with one real agent run that reads a word from a screenshot, and open a pull request that names no other product.
